primary_customer_problem: Technical and funding decisions are delayed or rejected when the source, eligibility rules, baseline, metric, holdout, evidence lineage, limitations, and decision authority are not locked into one inspectable record.
primary_positioning: ProofLock is a buyer-controlled opportunity-assurance workflow that converts one funding opportunity into a source-grounded pursue-or-stop decision and a replayable package plan without promising eligibility, award, acceptance, or submission.

review_instruments.title: Proof Capsule verifier v3
review_instruments.purpose: Strict schema, source identity, exact-file custody, resource limits, and bounded machine receipt.
review_instruments.claim_boundary: A passing local replay establishes only the declared first-party software and custody checks.

review_instruments.title: CODECHECK executable-computation target
review_instruments.purpose: Recreate the six declared outputs from one immutable public source commit.
review_instruments.claim_boundary: No codechecker assignment, independent execution receipt, report, or certificate is claimed.

review_instruments.title: Agent Arena V5 adversarial holdout harness
review_instruments.purpose: Measure bounded agent proposals under frozen selection, holdout, adversarial, scoring, and custody rules.
review_instruments.claim_boundary: The reference run is synthetic software evidence, fails its zero-violation absolute gate, and does not establish Byzantine tolerance, field performance, production safety, savings, or external validation.

review_instruments.title: External replication docket
review_instruments.purpose: Give a qualified non-author evaluator control of source access, held-out execution, analysis, deviations, and reporting.
review_instruments.claim_boundary: No evaluator, external result, field validation, certification, savings, deployment, or endorsement is claimed.

claim_boundary: This docket is an author-maintained navigation and status record. Repository checks, deterministic replays, hashes, and deployment receipts establish only their declared software, custody, and byte-identity properties. They do not establish scientific validation, field performance, customer value, eligibility, award, certification, endorsement, or commercial acceptance.
